purpose: Exploratory matched-input comparison; reference is an existing generated three-view sheet, not an independent source portrait.

assessment.method: Qualitative visual inspection of both replicates; no blinded raters, no fixed seed, no biometric or skin-quality scoring.
assessment.conclusion: Subtle texture differences, but no demonstrated consistent overall improvement in this small sample.
observations: Both versions broadly retain the reference face, hairstyle and outfit.
The revised outputs suggest slightly more apparent cheek/nose texture, but the difference is small and not a robust superiority finding.
The first revised sample also has somewhat more apparent under-eye shading; more visible texture should not be equated with greater naturalness.
No clear repeatable improvement in gaze or compliance with the specified camera-left key light.
The second revised output omits one front-view hand and shows only part of the other.
Portrait clothing/shoulders extend beyond the nominal rightmost third in all samples; the revised outputs do not solve this.
limitations: A generated three-view sheet is reused as reference, priming composition and appearance.
Exact model version and seed are not exposed by the tool.
The tool returned 1672x941 rather than the requested 2048x1152; skin microdetail is difficult to judge.
Only the default semi-matte/natural-detail/calm setting was compared; other states and expressions were not validated.
